sleeping: SLEEPING: both eyes remain fully closed in ALL 12 frames with dark furry upper eyelids, no cream disks with smile lines. Both hands hug the prop. One quiet breath: torso gently expands no more than 2%, mittens lift a tiny amount then settle. Head, feet and prop stay stable. Frames 1-6 slowly inhale, 7-12 slowly exhale, last matches first.
idle: IDLE: one hand fixed supporting the prop; the other releases its original grip and performs this affectionate small action: {action}. Frames 1 rest, 2 release, 3 rise one third, 4 rise two thirds, 5 approach, 6 gentle contact, 7 hold contact, 8 lift away, 9 lower two thirds, 10 lower one third, 11 approach rest, 12 exact rest again. Arms genuinely bend, prop stays at a fixed height.
thinking: THINKING: exactly one hand remains supporting the prop, the other LEAVES the prop and rests against cheek/temple. The free hand starts at cheek, rises slightly, gently taps temple, then returns to cheek. Twelve small evenly spaced inbetweens, fixed forward gaze, no looking around. Pensive soft expression. Do NOT leave an extra hand on the prop.
working: WORKING: one hand fixed supporting the prop, the other performs the task: {action}. Make the articulated working movement clear but restrained: 1 ready, 2 approach, 3 touch, 4 press/turn, 5 continue, 6 peak, 7 hold, 8 release, 9 retreat, 10 return, 11 settle, 12 ready again. Same object shape and size, no detached effects, feet and eye centers fixed.
waiting: WAITING IN QUEUE: prop tucked against chest, supported by ONE hand. Free hand makes a tiny patient palm-up gesture at waist height, then settles back to its side, twelve smooth inbetweens. Expression calm and attentive, no anxious tapping, no waving or celebration. Feet, eye centers and prop fixed; last pose matches first.
success: SUCCESS: a quiet pleased smile, prop held by ONE hand. The other mitten rises beside shoulder and gives ONE small friendly wave, then lowers to rest. Twelve progressive articulated poses, 1 rest, 2-4 lift, 5-7 small wave arc, 8-11 lower, 12 rest. No jump, confetti, stars, detached effects or changing eye size. Keep feet grounded.
error: ERROR: gentle concerned expression, not crying or panicking. Prop supported by ONE hand. Other mitten makes a small apologetic gesture toward its cheek then lowers again. Twelve smoothly spaced inbetweens, 1 rest, 2-5 lift, 6-7 touch cheek, 8-11 lower, 12 rest. Fixed eye centers and pupil gaze; no tears, symbols, question marks or effects.
